Salon Jean Paul Kuilsriver is a unisex hair salon trading from Shop 3 in the Shoprite Centre on Van Riebeeck Road, Kuils River. The salon's service menu covers women's and children's haircuts, curly hair care, balayage and colour work, keratin treatments, permanent straightening and perms, along with hair braiding, extensions and weaves, giving clients a single place to handle both everyday cuts and more involved colour or texture changes.

Part of the small Salon Jean Paul group with branches in the northern suburbs, the salon draws on established technique for braiding and extension work that needs a practised hand, while still offering the quicker services most clients come in for. It is based in the Shoprite Centre in Kuils River, close to the De Kuilen area, and is open seven days a week for walk-ins and bookings alike.

Salon Jean Paul is a hairdressing and barber salon operating from Voortrekker Road in Parow East, offering the everyday services a neighbourhood hair salon is built around: washes, cuts, blow-dries, colouring and styling for men, women and children. Salons of this kind typically work on a walk-in and appointment basis, with stylists handling anything from a quick trim to a full colour or treatment, and many also offer barbering for male clients alongside the usual ladies' hairdressing menu.

Trading under the same name as sister salons elsewhere in the northern suburbs, it serves the Parow East community from its Voortrekker Road premises, a busy commercial strip with steady passing foot traffic. It remains a straightforward option for residents wanting a local salon for routine haircuts and colour work without needing to travel into the city for an appointment.

Sapphire Spa operates from the Romney Park complex in Green Point, offering five private treatment rooms alongside a hydrotherapy tub, a flotation tank and individual steam, shower and locker facilities for guests who want a full wellness visit rather than a single treatment. A team of therapists runs the treatment side, covering intense pulsed light therapy and microdermabrasion for anti-ageing and photo rejuvenation, along with permanent hair removal and treatments aimed at reducing the appearance of stretch marks, plus mud massage and hot stone therapy for relaxation.

The spa also retails skincare lines including Matis and Decleor for clients who want to continue a treatment at home. Set within the Romney Park hotel and apartment complex on the corner of Hill and Romney Roads in Green Point, it draws both hotel guests and local residents looking for a quiet, modern space for facial and body treatments.

Shoprite Dunoon is a branch of South Africa's largest grocery retailer, trading from The Stables Shopping Centre on Potsdam Road. Like other Shoprite stores, it stocks a full grocery range alongside household essentials, with regular Xtra Savings promotions and bulk specials rotated through the store, and shoppers can use the Money Market counter for bill payments, airtime and other everyday transactions without needing a separate errand.

The store serves Dunoon's roughly 80,000 residents together with the surrounding industrial area, giving the neighbourhood a full-range supermarket within reach rather than requiring a trip to a mall further afield. For households doing a weekly or top-up grocery shop in Dunoon, it functions as the area's anchor store for food, toiletries and basic home goods.

Shoprite Elsies River is a branch of the Shoprite supermarket chain on the corner of Owen and Halt Road, stocking groceries, fresh produce, meat and household essentials for shoppers in the area. As with other Shoprite stores, the range runs from basic pantry staples to seasonal promotions, with the chain's Xtra Savings specials and Sixty60 delivery service extending the store's reach to customers who would rather shop from home than queue in person.

Shoprite has built its name nationally on keeping everyday prices low, and the Elsies River branch carries that positioning through to a neighbourhood that relies on accessible, affordable grocery shopping. Trading from its corner site, the store gives local households a straightforward option for a full weekly shop without travelling to a larger centre.

Shoprite Macassar is a branch of the Shoprite supermarket chain trading from the corner of Hospital and Bergh Streets in Macassar Shopping Centre. Like Shoprite stores elsewhere, it carries a full grocery range, fresh produce and household essentials, with the chain's regular catalogue specials and loyalty promotions giving shoppers discounts on bulk staples, cleaning products and seasonal items throughout the year.

The store anchors Macassar Shopping Centre and gives the Macassar community a full-range supermarket close to home rather than a drive to Somerset West or further into the metro. For residents doing their weekly grocery shop, it offers the same low-price positioning and nationwide buying power that Shoprite is known for, packaged into a single neighbourhood store.

Shoprite Steenberg is a branch of the Shoprite supermarket chain trading from Steenberg Centre on Military Road, also known locally as the Food World Centre. The store carries the standard Shoprite grocery range, from fresh produce and meat to pantry staples and household goods, and shoppers can expect the same rotating Xtra Savings catalogue and bulk promotions found across the chain's stores nationally.

Steenberg Centre sits within easy reach of Steenberg and the neighbouring Retreat and Lavender Hill areas, making this branch a convenient full-range grocery stop for residents who would otherwise need to travel further for a comparable shop. As with any Shoprite store, the focus stays on affordable everyday prices rather than a specialised or boutique offering, suited to routine household shopping.

Shoprite Town Centre is a branch of the national Shoprite supermarket chain trading from Symphony Walk in Mitchells Plain Town Centre, with an attached liquor store alongside the main grocery floor. The store stocks the full Shoprite range of groceries, fresh produce and household goods, and customers can rely on the chain's usual Xtra Savings specials and seasonal catalogues for discounts on bulk and everyday items.

As one of the larger retail anchors in Mitchells Plain Town Centre, the store serves a high volume of shoppers doing their weekly or bulk grocery run in one stop, with the on-site liquor store adding a convenient extra for those combining errands. It represents the standard Shoprite offering, built around value pricing and a wide everyday range.

Simon's Town Bottle Store is an independently run liquor store on St George's Street, stocking the usual range a neighbourhood bottle store carries: beers, ciders, wines and spirits alongside soft drinks and mixers for customers putting together anything from a weekend braai to a dinner party. Running regular monthly promotions is typical of stores like this, giving regular customers a reason to check pricing before a bigger shop.

Being owner-managed rather than part of a large retail chain, the store can focus on personal service and local stock preferences rather than a standardised national range. Trading from St George's Street in the heart of Simon's Town, it serves both residents and the steady flow of visitors the historic harbour town attracts, offering a local alternative to driving out to a bigger liquor outlet.

Sitari Health Shop is a health and supplements store trading from Sitari Village Centre in Croydon, stocking natural health products including vitamins, tinctures, creams and essential oils. The shop is a registered stockist for the Willow Health range, carrying its capsules, powders, softgels and tissue salts, alongside other recognised supplement brands such as Solgar, Metagenics and Urban Vega for customers looking for a specific formulation or remedy.

Shops of this kind typically serve customers who prefer natural and complementary health products over conventional pharmacy lines, offering guidance on which supplement suits a particular need. Based in Sitari Village Centre in Croydon, within the broader Somerset West area, the shop gives local households a nearby source for everyday health and wellness products.

Snuffel & Snuif is a home-industry bakery trading from IPIC Shopping Centre in Kenridge, Durbanville, specialising in home-baked biscuits and cakes alongside other sweet treats suited to tea time or gifting. The bakery has built a following through the centre's own social pages, where its baked goods are regularly featured, and it takes orders directly from customers who contact the shop to arrange collection.

Alongside its baking, the shop also stocks home craft and gift items, giving customers a reason to browse even when they are not there for something sweet. Trading from IPIC Shopping Centre on Doordekraal Road in Kenridge, it serves the Durbanville area with a small-scale, personal alternative to a large commercial bakery.

Son of a Butcher & Deli is an independent butchery and deli on Regent Road in Sea Point, specialising in Wagyu beef, dry-aged free-range beef, Karoo lamb and pasture-raised poultry. The counter also carries less common cuts and products such as beef tallow, bone marrow butter and springbok sausage, giving regular customers access to items a standard supermarket meat aisle would not stock.

Customers who shop here often return for the advice from staff behind the counter, who help put together orders ranging from a single cut for dinner to large bulk selections packed for travel. Trading from Regent Road in Sea Point, the shop positions itself as a local alternative to the big grocery chains, aimed at customers who want quality and traceability over simple convenience.

Sorbet Salon Sun Valley is a beauty salon inside Sun Valley Mall in Sunnydale, part of the national Sorbet Group. The treatment menu runs from manicures, pedicures and specialised MediPedi treatments to gel nails, nail repair and nail rehab, alongside waxing, facials, brow and lash services, threading and eyebrow shaping, giving clients a single stop for most routine beauty treatments rather than visiting separate specialists.

As with other Sorbet salons, the focus is on a consistent, trained service standard across the group's branches, with staff handling both quick treatments and longer beauty appointments. Based inside Sun Valley Mall on the corner of Ou Kaapse Weg and Buller Louw Boulevard, the salon serves the Sunnydale and Noordhoek area with a familiar, branded beauty option close to home.

SPAR Firgrove is a branch of the SPAR supermarket chain trading from the corner of the R102 and Main Road in Firgrove. Like other SPAR stores, it stocks a full grocery range covering fresh produce, meat, bakery and household essentials, along with everyday toiletries and cleaning products, giving shoppers a complete weekly shop without needing to travel into Somerset West.

SPAR operates on an independently owned franchise model, which often lets a store respond more directly to what its local customers want on the shelves than a purely centralised chain would. Trading from its corner site on the R102 in Firgrove, the store serves the small Firgrove community along with passing traffic on the route between Somerset West and the surrounding farmland.

Specsavers Gordon's Bay is a branch of the national Specsavers optometry and eyewear group, operating from Gordon's Bay Mall on Sir Lowry's Pass Road. As with other Specsavers stores, the practice combines eye testing with a retail range of spectacle frames, sunglasses and contact lenses, and many branches also offer audiology services for customers needing a hearing test or hearing aids alongside their eye care.

Specsavers runs on a franchise model across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and Swaziland, with qualified optometrists at each store responsible for eye health checks and vision correction. Based in Gordon's Bay Mall, the branch gives local residents a recognised, chain-backed option for eye tests and eyewear without travelling into Somerset West.

St Vincent Clinic is a public primary healthcare facility on St Vincent Drive in Belhar, operated by the Western Cape Government as part of the Tygerberg Eastern Health District. As a government-run medical clinic, it provides the services typical of a community day clinic, including general consultations, chronic medication management and services linked to disability and social grant assessments for patients who need a doctor's evaluation.

Clinics of this kind carry a high daily patient load, and St Vincent Clinic is no exception, serving a wide catchment of households in Belhar and the surrounding suburbs who rely on it for accessible, no-cost healthcare rather than private medical consultations. Based on St Vincent Drive, it remains one of the main points of access to public healthcare for the local community.

Steers Kromboom Rd is a branch of the Steers flame-grilled fast-food chain, trading from Shop 3 in the Spar Building on Kromboom Road in Crawford. The menu follows the chain's long-standing format of flame-grilled 100% beef burgers, chicken and pork loin ribs, served with hand-cut chips and thick milkshakes, including the King Steer burger that has remained one of Steers' best-selling orders for more than two decades.

Steers has been serving this style of flame-grilled food since the 1960s, and the Crawford branch carries that same menu through dine-in, takeaway and delivery via the Steers app. Trading from the Spar Building on Kromboom Road, the outlet serves the Crawford area with a familiar, fast turnaround option for lunch, dinner or a late-night order.

Strandfontein Post Office is a branch of the South African Post Office on the corner of Benguela Street and Wave Crescent in Strandfontein. Like other post office branches, it handles counter services such as mail collection and dispatch, parcel services, bill payments and basic postal banking, giving residents access to postal and financial counter services without needing to travel to a larger branch.

The office serves the Strandfontein community and surrounding False Bay-area suburbs, functioning as a local point of access for services that have otherwise moved online or require an in-person counter visit, such as collecting a registered parcel. Based on the corner of Benguela Street and Wave Crescent, it remains a routine stop for residents handling postal and counter errands.

Surfside Restaurant is a bistro-style restaurant inside the Strand Pavilion complex on Beach Road in Strand, serving a menu built around seafood, steak and sushi. The combination gives diners a wider spread than a typical seaside eatery, covering anything from a simple grilled fish to a full steak dinner or a sushi platter, which has made it a regular stop for both locals and visitors staying along this stretch of coast.

Part of the draw is the setting itself: diners get views over False Bay while they eat, a feature that sets the restaurant apart from inland options serving a similar menu. Trading from the Strand Pavilion complex, it serves the Strand area as a sit-down option for a proper meal, particularly suited to evenings and weekend outings.

SVG Autoworks is an independent workshop on Victoria Road in Southfield specialising in BMW and MINI servicing, diagnostics and repairs. As a Motor Industry Workshop Association member, the workshop operates to the trade body's standards for independent specialists, giving customers an alternative to dealership pricing while still working on vehicles that need brand-specific knowledge and diagnostic equipment.

The workshop takes bookings online and offers Saturday appointments, which suits customers who cannot bring a vehicle in during the working week. Trading from Victoria Road in Southfield, it serves BMW and MINI owners across the southern suburbs who want a specialist rather than a general mechanic, covering everything from routine services to more involved diagnostic and repair work on these specific marques.

Tafelsig Secondary School is a public secondary school in Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain, operating under the Western Cape Education Department and offering the standard national curriculum through to matric. The school is classified as a Quintile 4 institution, which places it among the fee-paying public schools, with tuition fees set annually by the school's governing body rather than being fixed nationally.

As with other public schools in the province, uniform and general conduct policies are set in line with the Western Cape Education Department's guidelines, giving families a consistent standard across the school's grades. Serving the Tafelsig area of Mitchells Plain, the school remains one of the local options for secondary education in a part of the Cape Flats where access to nearby, affordable schooling matters to most households.

Telecom Installations CC is a telecommunications installer based in Stellenberg, Durbanville, providing PABX systems, intercoms, CCTV, public address systems and VoIP and data cabling for both households and businesses. The company also supplies cordless phones, headsets, telephone management systems, answering machines and conference telephones, alongside second-hand PABX equipment when it becomes available, giving clients options beyond buying new.

Installation is handled by an in-house trained team rather than subcontracted labour, which the company uses to back up its promise of a prompt response to call-outs and ongoing upgrades or maintenance on systems it has already installed. Operating from Stellenberg in Durbanville, it serves businesses and homes across the northern suburbs needing anything from a small office intercom to a full PABX and data cabling installation.

Terry's Beds is a bedding and mattress showroom on Main Road in Plumstead, part of the Richmond Centre retail strip in the Southern Suburbs. The showroom stocks a wide range of beds and mattresses, including well-known brands such as Edblo and Serta, giving customers a chance to compare different firmness levels and sizes in person rather than ordering a mattress without testing it first.

As a dedicated bedding specialist rather than a general furniture store, the showroom can carry a deeper range of mattress options and sizes than a department store bedding section typically would. Trading from Main Road in Plumstead, it serves households across the Southern Suburbs looking to replace a bed or mattress, with staff on hand to talk through the differences between ranges before a purchase.

The Cake Shop is a bakery on the corner of Belgravia and Port Jackson Roads in Athlone, specialising in cakes, croissants, scones, Danish pastries, doughnuts, artisan bread, pies and koeksisters. The range covers both everyday baked goods and more occasion-driven items such as celebration cakes, and the bakery takes direct orders by phone for customers who want to arrange a specific collection time.

Delivery is available for customers who would rather have their order brought to them than collect it in person, a service the bakery promotes through its own social media alongside regular specials on particular days. Trading from its corner site in Athlone, the bakery serves the local community with a mix of daily bread and pastry items and made-to-order cakes for birthdays and other occasions.

The Crazy Store is a discount variety retailer trading from 3Arts Village in Plumstead, part of South Africa's largest discount variety chain. The store's departments span books, stationery, arts and crafts, toys, games and sporting goods, household items, DIY and hardware basics, electrical goods and batteries, fashion and personal care, outdoor and camping gear, party supplies and pet products, covering a wide spread of everyday needs under one roof.

As one of the anchor tenants at 3Arts Village, the store draws steady foot traffic from shoppers visiting the centre for other errands who then pick up something unplanned on the way out. Trading from Main Road in Plumstead, it gives the surrounding Southern Suburbs a low-cost option for everyday household items, seasonal goods and gifts.

The Crazy Store Gordon's Bay is a branch of the national discount variety chain, trading from Shop 1 in Mountain View Shopping Centre on Avondrus Street. Alongside its usual household goods, toys, stationery and gifts, the branch is also listed as a dedicated source for balloons and craft supplies, making it a regular stop for customers putting together party decorations or a gift on short notice.

As with other Crazy Store branches, the appeal lies in a wide, low-cost range rather than a specialist selection, letting customers pick up anything from kitchenware to seasonal decorations in one visit. Trading from Mountain View Shopping Centre, the store serves the Gordon's Bay community as a convenient, affordable option for everyday and occasional shopping needs.

The Creamery Café is an ice cream and coffee café on Park Road in Mouille Point, the first branch of The Creamery to open on the Atlantic Seaboard. The café serves handmade, locally sourced ice cream alongside coffee, milkshakes and desserts, giving visitors a reason to stop in on a walk along the Mouille Point promenade rather than only for a full sit-down meal.

Being the brand's first Atlantic Seaboard location gave it an early foothold in an area well known for its seafront walks and tourist footfall, and the café has kept its focus narrow around ice cream and coffee rather than expanding into a full restaurant menu. Trading from Park Road in Mouille Point, it serves both residents and visitors looking for a casual treat close to the water.

The Designer Warehouse Emporium is a factory-shop clothing and accessories store on Voortrekker Road in Maitland, trading since 2008 and stocking ranges for babies, boys, girls, ladies and gents. Operating as a factory shop rather than a standard retail boutique lets the store offer a wider stock turnover at lower prices than typical mall fashion outlets, appealing to customers looking for value over brand-name mark-ups.

Alongside in-store shopping, the business takes orders through its social media pages, with customers reporting quick turnaround on delivery after placing an order this way. Trading from Voortrekker Road in Maitland, the store serves shoppers from across greater Cape Town looking for affordable family clothing, drawing customers willing to travel for the combination of range and price.

The Grillfather Westridge is a grill restaurant trading from Shop 15A in Westridge Shopping Centre in Westridge, Mitchells Plain, serving burgers, steak, chicken and ribs. The restaurant is best known locally for its Tsek Burger, and it runs on a deliberately small, focused menu rather than trying to cover every fast-food category, which has helped it build a loyal following among regulars in the area.

Keeping the menu tight allows the kitchen to focus on consistency for its core dishes rather than spreading attention across a long list of options, a trade-off that has worked in the restaurant's favour with Mitchells Plain diners. Trading from Westridge Shopping Centre, it serves the local community with a casual dine-in and takeaway option for grilled food.

The Holland Bakery specialises in traditional Dutch-style baked goods, trading from the corner of Durban and Voortrekker Roads in Bellville and part of the Cape community since 1991. Everything is baked fresh daily from scratch using recipes brought from the Netherlands, with signature items including Bossche Bollen, stroopkoeken and giant stroopwafels filled with cinnamon caramel, alongside the bakery's wider range of Dutch sweet and savoury treats.

The goods are made locally in Kraaifontein and can be delivered anywhere in South Africa, extending the bakery's reach well beyond its physical counter. Trading from its Bellville corner site, the bakery gives customers the choice of visiting the café in person for a Dutch treat and coffee or ordering online for delivery, more than three decades after it first opened.

The Taproom is the on-site pub and restaurant at Devil's Peak Brewing Company in Salt River, serving food alongside the brewery's own craft beer brewed metres from where customers sit. The kitchen is built around a well-regarded cheeseburger, available in a smaller size for a light lunch or a larger version for a full meal, plus a Philly cheesesteak roll, chicken and waffles and beer-battered fish and chips.

Running a kitchen alongside an active brewery gives the Taproom a different draw from an ordinary gastropub, since customers can watch the brewing process while they eat and pair their meal directly with beer made on site. Trading from Durham Avenue in Salt River, it serves beer and burger fans from across the city rather than only the immediate neighbourhood.

Thumbs Up Plumbing & Construction is a plumbing and building contractor based on Plettenberg Street in Monte Vista, handling general plumbing repairs and installations alongside broader building and construction work. Combining both trades under one business lets customers use the same contractor for a plumbing fix and a related building job, such as fixing a leak and then repairing the wall or floor it damaged, without bringing in two separate teams.

The business positions itself on guaranteed workmanship at competitive rates, a common selling point among smaller trade contractors competing against larger firms with higher overheads. Operating from Monte Vista, it serves households and property owners across the northern suburbs needing anything from a routine plumbing call-out to a small building project handled by the same team.

Tortuga Loca is a Mexican and Latin American restaurant on Main Road in Muizenberg, built around a sustainability-focused, laid-back surf-culture atmosphere with reclaimed wood furnishings and colourful murals. The menu includes vegetarian and vegan options alongside its Mexican and Latin dishes, and the restaurant pairs its food with mojitos and other cocktails suited to its relaxed setting, often with South American music playing in the background.

The restaurant has also built a reputation for eco-conscious choices such as non-plastic takeaway packaging, a detail regular customers have picked up on and mentioned favourably. Trading from Main Road in Muizenberg, it has become popular enough that booking ahead is recommended, serving both locals and the steady flow of visitors drawn to Muizenberg's surf and beach culture.

Totalsports at The Junxion Mall in Philippi is a branch of the national sportswear retail chain, part of the TFG group. The store positions itself as a leading sporting goods destination, working as a strategic retail partner for global brands including Nike, Adidas, Asics and Puma, which gives shoppers access to current footwear, apparel and equipment across football, running and general fitness categories.

Being part of a large retail group gives the Philippi branch the buying power to stock recognised international brands at a scale a smaller independent sports shop could not easily match. Trading from Shop 57 in The Junxion Mall on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Roads, it serves the Philippi community with a mainstream sportswear option close to home.

Van Schaik Bookstore is a branch of South Africa's largest specialist academic book chain, trading from Riverside Mall in Rondebosch. With 58 stores across the country and two more in Namibia, built up over roughly a century of supplying academic books to students, Van Schaik also serves as an official UNISA bookseller, giving distance-learning students access to the specific textbooks their courses require.

The branch runs a dedicated contact centre function to help customers track down the right edition for a particular course, reducing the back-and-forth that can come with ordering academic texts. Trading from Riverside Mall on the corner of Main and Belmont Roads in Rondebosch, it serves students from the surrounding university area alongside general readers looking for stationery and non-academic titles.

Vee's Video is a DVD and games rental store trading from Lakeside Centre on Main Road in Lakeside. The shop stocks the latest DVD releases alongside a back catalogue of cult films and complete box-set series, giving customers a physical rental option in a market where most video stores of this kind have closed in favour of streaming.

Staff on the floor are available to make recommendations, a point of difference from browsing a streaming catalogue alone, particularly for customers looking for something specific or a bit more obscure than the newest releases. Trading from Lakeside Centre, the shop serves a loyal base of local customers who still prefer renting a physical disc, keeping a small, old-fashioned rental business running in an era when most competitors have shut down.

The Village Harbour & Pizza House is a casual eatery in Strandfontein Village specialising in wood-fired pizza and fresh fish and chips. The kitchen focuses on these two items rather than running a broad menu, which has built a loyal following among regulars who return specifically for the pizza base and the quality of the fried fish, both prepared to order rather than kept warming under a counter light.

Customers can eat in, collect a takeaway or arrange delivery, giving the restaurant flexibility for a sit-down dinner or a quick order on a weeknight. Trading from Blackberry Mall Road in Strandfontein Village, it serves the Strandfontein community as a reliable local option for pizza and seafood without needing to travel further along the coast.

Village Skincare & Medi Spa is a skin, beauty and aesthetics clinic trading from Meadowridge Shopping Centre on Howard Drive in Meadowridge, registered as a healthcare-adjacent organisation rather than an ordinary beauty salon. The clinic offers facials, skin peels and other medi-spa treatments performed by qualified therapists, positioning itself on the clinical end of the beauty spectrum rather than purely cosmetic pampering.

That distinction matters to clients dealing with specific skin concerns rather than general relaxation, since treatments are carried out under a more formal, trained framework than a typical day spa would offer. Trading from Meadowridge Shopping Centre, the clinic serves clients across the southern suburbs looking for targeted skin treatment and aesthetic care close to home.

Virgin Active Sun Valley is a health club inside Sun Valley Mall on the corner of Ou Kaapse Weg and Buller Louw Boulevard, offering a gym floor, a swimming pool and a schedule of group fitness classes. As part of the national Virgin Active network, the club gives members access to standardised equipment and class formats that carry over between branches, useful for members who travel or move between areas but want to keep the same gym membership.

Having both a pool and group classes on site sets the club apart from a basic gym-only setup, covering swimming, group training and individual gym use in one membership. Based inside Sun Valley Mall, it serves the Sun Valley and Noordhoek area as the local option for members who would otherwise need to travel further for a full-service health club.

Vredenhof Organic Estate is a farm restaurant and organic produce estate on Bredell Road in Firgrove, serving breakfast and lunch alongside a working farm stall. The kitchen's menu runs to quiches, pastas, wood-fired pizzas and sugar-free desserts, paired with the estate's own organic wines, while the farm stall stays stocked with fresh fruit and vegetables for customers who want to buy produce rather than only eat on site.

A playground on the property makes the estate a popular stop for families with young children, giving parents somewhere to let kids play while they eat or browse the farm stall. Trading from Bredell Road in Firgrove, the estate draws visitors from across the Somerset West area looking for a relaxed farm setting rather than a standard restaurant.

Wellness Warehouse at Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre is a health and wellness retailer stocking natural health, beauty and food products alongside supplements and baby and family care items. Beyond the retail shelves, the branch also offers in-store massage treatments, giving customers a reason to visit for a booked appointment rather than only to shop for products.

As part of the national Wellness Warehouse chain, the store benefits from the group's buying relationships with natural health and wellness brands, giving it a wider range than a small independent health shop could usually stock. Trading from Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre on the corner of Plattekloof Road and Baronetcy Boulevard, it serves the Plattekloof area with a combined retail and treatment option for everyday wellness needs.

Wellness Warehouse Steenberg Village is a health and wellness retailer trading from Steenberg Village in Tokai, stocking health foods, beauty products and eco-friendly home goods alongside a natural medicine dispensary. The branch also offers in-store wellness assessments and acupuncture treatments, extending its role beyond a straightforward retail shop into a place customers can book a consultation or treatment.

Having a dispensary and treatment services on site sets this branch apart from a purely retail health shop, letting customers combine picking up supplements with an actual appointment in one visit. Trading from Reddam Avenue in Steenberg Village, Tokai, the store serves the surrounding southern suburbs with a fuller range of natural health services than most neighbourhood health shops offer.

Westpoint Properties is an estate agency and property development company based on Carlton Close in Sunnydale, specialising in residential property sales across the Sun Valley and Noordhoek area. Combining agency work with property development gives the business a broader role in the local market than a standard estate agency, covering both the sale of existing homes and involvement in new residential developments in the area.

Operating from a fixed base in Sunnydale rather than a large branch network, the company can focus its local market knowledge on a defined patch of the southern peninsula rather than spreading attention across the wider city. Based on Carlton Close, it serves buyers and sellers across Sun Valley and Noordhoek looking for an agency with a direct, local footprint in the area.

Wetton Hardware is a hardware and building-materials store on Dolphin Way in Wetton, stocking sand, cement, bricks, paint, timber, tiling tools and security products for both trade customers and homeowners. The range covers everything from basic building materials for a renovation to smaller items like paint and tiling tools for a weekend DIY job, giving the store a broad customer base beyond just contractors.

Staff are available to advise on waterproofing and building plans, which matters to customers tackling a job they are not fully confident about without guidance from someone familiar with building regulations and materials. Trading from Dolphin Way in Wetton, the store serves the surrounding southern suburbs as a local hardware supplier for both small home projects and larger building jobs.

Whole Earth Cafe is a health-focused cafe on Main Road in Scarborough, serving breakfast dishes, salads and falafel alongside vegan, raw and gluten-free options. The menu is built specifically around dietary need rather than offering a few token alternatives, which has made it a regular stop for visitors following a particular way of eating rather than a general seaside cafe menu.

Cold-pressed juices and smoothies round out the offering, giving customers a lighter option alongside the food menu for a quick stop rather than a full sit-down meal. Trading from Main Road in Scarborough, the cafe serves both local residents and the steady stream of visitors drawn to this quiet stretch of the peninsula, offering a dedicated healthy-eating option in an area with few direct alternatives.

Wizard Pets is a pet supply wholesaler and retailer trading from Delia Road in Grassy Park, stocking everyday pet essentials including leashes, harnesses, puppy starter kits and a range of scratch and puppy toys. Operating as both a wholesaler and retailer lets the business serve individual pet owners doing a routine shop alongside customers buying in bulk, such as breeders or smaller pet shops restocking their own shelves.

The business also offers shipping for customers based outside Cape Town, extending its reach well beyond the immediate Grassy Park area to pet owners who cannot easily get to the store in person. Trading from Delia Road in Grassy Park, it serves the local community as a straightforward pet supply shop while still reaching a wider customer base through its wholesale and delivery side.

Woodlands Secondary School is a public, no-fee high school in Woodlands, Mitchells Plain, built in 1978 as one of the area's older secondary schools. The school currently has around 37 teachers serving a roll of more than 1,100 learners, making it one of the larger secondary schools in the immediate area and a long-standing option for families in Woodlands needing accessible secondary education.

Operating as a no-fee public school keeps the school accessible to households across Woodlands and the surrounding Mitchells Plain suburbs, a significant factor for a community where school fees can be a barrier to consistent attendance. Based on Mitchell Avenue in Woodlands, the school continues to serve as one of the established secondary schools for the area, nearly five decades after it first opened its doors.

Woolworths Food at the Engen False Bay 1 Stop is a convenience grocery store operating inside the 24-hour fuel and travel stop on the N2 in Macassar. Alongside the usual Woolworths grocery range of fresh snacks, ready meals and drinks, the site combines several food options under one roof, including a Wimpy outlet, giving travellers a choice between a quick grocery grab and a sit-down meal during a stop.

Being built into a round-the-clock service station means the store caters heavily to passing traffic on the N2 rather than functioning as a neighbourhood supermarket, stocking a more travel-focused range than a standalone Woolworths branch would. Trading on the N2 in Macassar, it serves motorists and travellers needing a reliable food stop at any hour of the day or night.

Woolworths at Mountain View Shopping Centre is a branch of the national grocery chain, trading from the corner of Avondrus Street and Sir Lowry's Pass Road in Gordon's Bay.
